meta.title: Award an unverified vendor
gaps: The catalog cannot independently verify that Vendor C is unverified and the lowest bidder before attempting the award.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: The catalog cannot independently verify that Vendor C is unverified and the lowest bidder before attempting the award.

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ with the bid already present.
Open the comparison grid and confirm Vendor C is the bidder targeted for awarding.

args.because: You cannot select bid for an unverified vendor.

steps.note: Attempt to allocate Vendor C and create the proposal; pass only if Procol refuses with the required message.
